param_input_item.param_description: a uint8 vector (raw bytes) or a character vector (UTF-8 bytes): content to sign.
a string: existing file whose raw bytes are signed.
a uint8 vector of 32 bytes or 64 hexadecimal characters: private Ed25519 seed.

param_output_item.param_description: a character vector: 128 lowercase hexadecimal characters (64 bytes).
a character vector: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters (32 bytes), public key derived from the seed.

description.p: crypto.ed25519.sign computes a pure Ed25519 signature (RFC 8032, section 5.1) over the exact bytes of a message. Signatures are deterministic: the same seed and message always give the same signature.

The seed is the 32-byte private key. Keep it secret: anyone holding it can sign. This function is intended for tests, local development and private package registries; the public key returned as second output is the value to distribute to verifiers.

example_item.example_item_description: sign a text message and verify it
